descript.abstract: This map contains one point for every port defined in the ADF&G Division of Commercial Fisheries Fish Ticket System. Most locations were taken from the ADF&G coverage du_towns_2002. The majority of these came from the USGS GNIS. Where there was no match with du_towns_2002, nautical charts or topographic maps were used to locate the port.
descript.purpose: Useful for making general maps showing the locations of ports in Alaska, and for mapping commercial fisheries landings by port. For most locations, these points are suitable for mapping at scales of 1:63,360 or smaller. These points do not necessarily portray the locations of processing facilities.
